newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai property developer Somprasong to pay debt.
newsitem.headline: Thai property developer Somprasong to pay debt.

text.p: Thai property developer Somprasong Land Plc said on Thursday it would transfer land worth 264.5 million baht ($10.58 million) to pay back debt owed to National Finance and Securities Plc.

Somprasong Land said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that its board decided on Tuesday to transfer land in Bangkok's neighbouring province of Pathum Thani to pay back debt plus interest amounting to 178.39 million baht to National Finance and Securities.

The company's announcement came after Olarn Chaipravat, president of the Siam Commercial Bank Plc, said on Wednesday that his bank would join Bangkok Bank Plc, National Finance and Securities and Ekachart Finance and Securities Plc, in setting up a fund amounting 1.8 billion baht to buy prime land owned by Somprasong Land.
He said Somprasong owed Bangkok Bank about 700 million baht in outstanding debts, 600 million to National Finance, 400 million to Ekachart, and 110 million to Siam Commercial.
